claim: the NTE domain end to end: HR issues a case, the named employee responds, HR resolves it with a disciplinary outcome

checks.name: HR reaches /app/hr/nte with the case form
incident type is a free-text field
createNteCase writes a case
new case starts in status 'issued'
case is issued by the HR user
incident date stored as typed
employee sees their own case on /app/my/nte
deadline shown to the employee is the date HR typed
employee gets a response form for their case
submitNteResponse writes a response
responding moves the case to 'under_review'
second case created for another employee
another employee's NTE case is not visible to this employee
the HR search filter narrows the list to the case under test
resolve form is shown while the case is open
resolve confirmation dialog opens
resolveNteCase sets status 'resolved'
resolveNteCase stores the resolution type
a non-cleared resolution writes a disciplinary action
a stale tab is refused: the case cannot be resolved from status 'resolved'
the refused attempt wrote no second disciplinary action
the refusal left the resolution untouched
no unexpected console errors
no page errors

notes: response_due_at stored as 2026-03-09T09:00:00+00:00 for a wall clock HR typed as 2026-03-09T17:00 (intended instant 2026-03-09T09:00:00.000Z, off by 0h).
